name: dzhoof-iptv
description: DZ HOOF server for managing channel lists, subscriptions, devices, and app updates

scripts.dev: concurrently -n backend,frontend -c blue,green "npm run dev -w @dzhoof/backend" "npm run dev -w @dzhoof/frontend"
scripts.build: npm run build -w @dzhoof/shared && npm run build -w @dzhoof/backend && npm run build -w @dzhoof/frontend
scripts.build:backend: npm run build -w @dzhoof/shared && npm run build -w @dzhoof/backend
scripts.lint:fix: npm run lint:fix -w @dzhoof/backend && npm run lint:fix -w @dzhoof/frontend
scripts.test: npm run test -w @dzhoof/backend && npm run test -w @dzhoof/frontend
scripts.typecheck: npm run build -w @dzhoof/shared && npm run typecheck -w @dzhoof/shared && npm run typecheck -w @dzhoof/backend

author: merci1994dz
